definitions.explanation: A series of connected metal links.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}を{鎖|くさり}でつないでおく。
examples.english: To keep the dog on a chain.

examples.japanese: {自転車|じてんしゃ}の{鎖|くさり}が{外|はず}れた。

notes:
{鎖|くさり} refers to chains made of linked metal.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {鎖|くさり}でつなぐ (to chain, to tie with a chain)
- {鎖|くさり}が{切|き}れる (the chain breaks)
- {鎖|くさり}を{外|はず}す (to unchain)

TYPES OF CHAINS:
- {自転車|じてんしゃ}の{鎖|くさり} (bicycle chain)
- ネックレスの{鎖|くさり} (necklace chain)
- {犬|いぬ}の{鎖|くさり} (dog chain)

FIGURATIVE USE:
- {因習|いんしゅう}の{鎖|くさり} (chains of tradition)
- {束縛|そくばく}の{鎖|くさり}を{断|た}つ (to break free from bonds)
